function.description: Deterministic compute, no code exec: op='hash' gives the hex digest of data (sha256 | sha3_256 | keccak256; encoding text|hex); op='fair_draw' sorts ids by sha256(seed + id) and takes n — the one fair-draw rule (core.fair_draw). Use it instead of hashing by hand or asking a web service; never send a seed or entrant data to a third party.
function.name: compute

algo.description: hash only. sha3_256 is NIST SHA-3; keccak256 is Ethereum's (they differ).

encoding.description: hash only: read data as UTF-8 text or as hex bytes.

ids.description: fair_draw only: the unique entrant ids (at most 5000).

n.description: fair_draw only: how many to draw.

op.description: 'hash' = a digest of data; 'fair_draw' = the provably fair draw.

seed.description: fair_draw only: the seed, used verbatim — for a block hash, the 0x-prefixed text the RPC returns.
